name: The Drunken
overview: Scripture warns that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise behavior, as they are described as mockers and sources of raging (Proverbs 20:1; Isaiah 5:22). Drunkenness is explicitly listed among sinful acts that exclude one from inheriting the kingdom of God (Galatians 5:21), highlighting the necessity for believers to crucify the flesh and its desires (Galatians 5:24). Furthermore, Christians are called to avoid anything, including drinking, that might cause a brother to stumble or be weakened in faith (Romans 14:21), emphasizing a Christ-centered approach to sobriety and self-control.
